name: Marcus
purpose: Find a paid internship or job lead near Berkeley for after graduation; skeptical of new apps.

language.notes: Native English; not used to app conventions like swipe cards or icon-only buttons.

backstory: I mostly use my phone for texting, email and Handshake when the career center tells me to. My little sister said this app has internships. I'm not giving my info to some random app unless it's clearly legit. Icons without words lose me.
quitsWhen: It wants my info before I know what it is
I can't find the internship part
It looks like a dating or party app
voice: Plain, slightly skeptical, polite. 'I don't get what this button does', 'Is this legit?'
